searches.query: (statin* OR atorvastatin OR rosuvastatin OR pravastatin OR simvastatin OR lovastatin) AND ("primary prevention") AND (elderly OR "older adults" OR "older people" OR "older persons" OR aged OR "70 years" OR "75 years" OR "65 years") AND ("meta-analysis" OR "systematic review" OR "meta analysis")

(statin*[ti] OR "lipid-lowering"[ti] OR "LDL-lowering"[ti]) AND (elderly[ti] OR older[ti] OR aged[ti] OR "75 years"[ti] OR "70 years"[ti] OR "65 years"[ti]) AND (meta-analysis[pt] OR meta-analys*[ti] OR "systematic review"[ti])
"Cholesterol Treatment Trialists" AND older AND statin

TITLE:(statin OR statins OR lipid-lowering OR cholesterol-lowering OR LDL) AND TITLE:(elderly OR older OR aged OR 75/70/65 years OR octogenarian*) AND (meta-analysis OR systematic review) AND OPEN_ACCESS:y
statin* AND "primary prevention" AND (elderly OR "older adults" OR "older people") AND "randomized controlled trials" AND TITLE:(meta-analysis OR systematic review) AND OPEN_ACCESS:y
meta-analysis randomized trials statins primary prevention older adults 70 years major cardiovascular events open access

search_log.screening: every hit's title screened; listed below = every efficacy/safety meta-analysis or systematic review of statins / lipid-lowering in older adults or in primary prevention. Off-topic hits (other drugs, adherence, cost, prediction models, unrelated protocols) are not listed.

note: C2-C6 judged from each meta's own abstract and, for candidates passing C1 and still in contention, its open full text. No information about our own pool was used.
